title: Press Release Sixfold Bioscience to Present at RNA Therapeutics 2025 Feb 5, 2025 Read more
body_markdown:
The two day[summit](https://www.smgconferences.com/pharmaceuticals/uk/conference/rna-therapeutics#tab_overview) held in London on the 10-11th of February 2025 will cover a range of topics on oligonucleotides and will feature leading industry experts from the RNA field, including: Roche, Moderna, J&J, Eli Lilly, GSK and Korro Bio.


Presentation: February 10th, 13:20pm (GMT)


- 'AI-powered RNA delivery'


Panel: February 10th, 15:50 (GMT)


- ‘Reviewing the advances in novel RNA modalities’
